acceptance: A PR whose head lacks a matching local review record is flagged or refused at pr-arm; trunk-revert PRs stay exempt.
description: During the oracle batch, #3835 and #3899 were opened with git push plus gh pr create, and #3829's final head was pushed after the local review blocked it, so make pr-open's local oracle review was skipped. Policy says make pr-open is the only creation path, but nothing enforces it. CI or pr-arm could require a local-review record bound to the patch digest (once the local findings record lands) or flag PRs without one.
